Overview

Discover Japan's mix of old and new. Explore Tokyo's busy streets, see Mt Fuji from Lake Kawaguchi, ride the Shinkansen bullet train to Kyoto's temples and gardens, feed the deer in Nara and finish with Osaka's street food. An expert guide joins you for the main days.

Tour highlights

  • Japan Rail / bullet train travel between cities
  • Tokyo: Asakusa, Shibuya Crossing and Tokyo Skytree
  • Mt Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi
  • Kyoto: Fushimi Inari, Kinkaku-ji and Arashiyama bamboo grove
  • Nara deer park and Todai-ji Temple
  • Osaka Castle and Dotonbori food street

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Tokyo

Fly from Mumbai to Tokyo. Transfer to your hotel. Evening at Shinjuku.

Day 2 Tokyo city tour

Guided tour of Senso-ji Temple in Asakusa, Meiji Shrine, Harajuku, Shibuya Crossing and Tokyo Skytree.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 Mt Fuji & Lake Kawaguchi

Day trip to the Mt Fuji area: Lake Kawaguchi, Chureito Pagoda and Oshino Hakkai village (Fuji views depend on weather).

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Free day in Tokyo

Day at leisure. Optional: Tokyo Disneyland, DisneySea or teamLab Planets.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Bullet train to Kyoto

Shinkansen to Kyoto (about 2 hours 15 minutes). Afternoon at Fushimi Inari Shrine and its thousands of red gates. Evening walk in Gion.

  • Breakfast
Day 6 Kyoto temples

Visit Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion), Arashiyama bamboo grove and Kiyomizu-dera.

  • Breakfast
Day 7 Nara, then to Osaka

Day trip to Nara to see the deer park and the giant Buddha at Todai-ji. Continue to Osaka.

  • Breakfast
Day 8 Osaka

Visit Osaka Castle and Shinsekai. Evening street food at Dotonbori. Optional: Universal Studios Japan.

  • Breakfast
Day 9 Depart for Mumbai

Transfer to Kansai airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast
